en.card.desc: Code graph: index status, symbol search, callers/callees/impact, one-click sync/index.
en.card.summary: Code graph: index status, symbol search, explore/context, impact analysis, one-click sync/index.
en.error.noClipboard: This environment has no navigator.clipboard (insecure context?)
en.hint.queryButtons: Search = symbol list (click through to details) · Explore = relevant symbol sources + call chains · Context = assemble context for a task · all three use the keyword on the left
en.list.noIndexHint: This directory has no index yet: click “Initialize index” below to run `codegraph init` once here (it only creates .codegraph/ and leaves source files alone; `codegraph uninit` removes it).
en.list.noSymbols: No matching symbols. Try another keyword, or drop the “Kind” filter.
en.list.outputTruncated: Long output: showing only the first {shown} characters (of {total})
en.list.statusEmpty: Index status has not been read yet.
en.meta.adoptionNoDiscovery: Adoption: no discovery calls yet (codegraph {codegraph} / reads {file}; {other} other tool calls)
en.meta.adoptionNoDiscoveryCalls: Adoption: no exploration calls yet ({other} other tool calls, e.g. bash / edit)
en.meta.adoptionNoRecords: Adoption: no tool calls recorded for this project during this host run
en.meta.adoptionUnindexed: (this project is not indexed, so the number does not reflect prompt effectiveness)
en.msg.cancelSent: Cancellation requested: the CLI process is being terminated (SIGTERM, forced after 3s).
en.msg.copyUnavailable: Auto-copy is unavailable ({error}): the diagnostic bundle is expanded below — select it all and copy manually.
en.msg.defaultSet: Default project switched to {path}{session}; “Follow the current project” was turned off and the codegraph MCP server will hot-switch.
en.msg.followOff: Following turned off; the managed row uses the default project
en.msg.mcpScopeManaged: Switched back to managed: the global managed row is restored and per-agent mounts are reclaimed
en.msg.mcpScopePerAgent: Switched to per-agent: new sessions each mount a separate MCP process (open sessions are backfilled too)
en.msg.noMatchingFiles: No matching files in the index
en.msg.reportCopied: Diagnostic bundle copied to the clipboard.
en.msg.reprobeFailed: Reprobe finished: the CLI is still unavailable — see the reason below.
en.msg.reprobeOk: Reprobe succeeded: the CLI is available and both systemPrompt sections are injected.
en.msg.switched: Switched to {path} and turned off “Follow the current project”; the codegraph MCP server will hot-switch.
en.msg.uninitDone: Removed the index for {path} (.codegraph/ deleted, source files untouched): {output}
en.panel.adoptionTitle: In-memory counters from the host (session/event tool/call), reset when the host restarts; projects are merged by index root. “File exploration” = tools like grep/glob/read that codegraph could have handled; bash and friends are not counted
en.panel.affectedButtonTitle: codegraph affected <files>: find the tests affected by the changed files. Uses the list in “Changed files” on the left
en.panel.affectedTitle: codegraph affected <files…>: find the tests affected by the changed files. One per line or comma-separated; leaving it empty makes the CLI answer “No files provided”
en.panel.announceDisabled: The codegraph CLI is unavailable, so the announcement is not injected
en.panel.announceTitle: Inject this plugin’s capability announcement into the agent (a short note in Chinese telling the model this card exists)
en.panel.cancelTitle: Terminate the running codegraph CLI (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL the whole group after 3s)
en.panel.confirmInitTitle: Click again to create .codegraph/ in {path} and build the first index
en.panel.confirmUninitTitle: Click again to delete .codegraph/ in {path} (all index data is lost; source files are untouched)
en.panel.contextTitle: codegraph context: assemble context for a task (relevant symbols + relations + code blocks). Uses the keyword in the search box on the left
en.panel.diagnoseTitle: Collect a copy-pasteable diagnostic text: the raw CLI probe result, the managed row and patch block (values redacted), index status, the codegraph daemon and log tail, and the last CLI failure
en.panel.exploreTitle: codegraph explore: same output as the MCP codegraph_explore (relevant symbol sources + call paths). Uses the keyword in the search box on the left
en.panel.filesTitle: codegraph files --json: list the file structure in the index (language / symbol count / size). Does not use the search box keyword
en.panel.followTitle: When on: switching to an indexed project aligns the MCP managed row’s cwd with it; when the session directory has no index it falls back to the default project. “Set as default project” turns it off (that is an explicit choice)
en.panel.guidanceDisabled: The codegraph CLI is unavailable, so the usage guidance is not injected
en.panel.guidanceTitle: Inject the CodeGraph usage guidance (the CODEGRAPH_START block: when to prefer codegraph and how to fall back when it fails)
en.panel.initTitle: codegraph index / sync both require an initialized project (a clean directory reports “CodeGraph not initialized”). This button runs `codegraph init` once in that directory.
en.panel.kindTitle: codegraph query -k/--kind: filter by node kind (function / class / method / interface / type_alias / constant / variable / property / file / import)
en.panel.limitTitle: codegraph query -l/--limit: maximum number of results (default 20). callers/callees use it too
en.panel.perAgentActive: per-agent is active: {count} agents have their own MCP process. The global managed row is suspended (disabled: true) and is restored when you switch back to managed.
en.panel.perAgentActiveTitle: One separate codegraph MCP process per agent; agents whose session directory has no usable index do not mount one (so they cannot pick up another project’s context)
en.panel.perAgentFallback: ⚠ per-agent is not in effect; fell back to managed: {reason}{tail}
en.panel.perAgentTail: (still a single server hot-switching per session — everything works normally)
en.panel.perAgentTitle: One separate codegraph MCP process per agent (cwd = that agent session’s index root): parallel projects no longer share a single global cwd and no longer need an on-disk hot switch. The cost is one child process per agent (about 40 MB each), and it mounts only when the session directory really “has an index”.
en.panel.refreshTitle: Re-read `codegraph status --json` to refresh this section’s index status (it does not rebuild the index)
en.panel.reportSummary: Diagnostic bundle (copy the whole thing into an issue)
en.panel.reprobeTitle: Re-run `<command> --version`: recovers without a host restart when the CLI was installed later or `command` was changed to an absolute path
en.panel.setDefaultTitle: Persist the current path as the default project (this also turns off “Follow the current project” so a session switch cannot override it); the codegraph MCP server’s working directory hot-switches with it
en.panel.syncTitle: codegraph sync: incrementally sync the index (only the changed parts; use “Reindex” on the right for a full rebuild)
en.panel.telemetryOn: Anonymous usage statistics: on (init / reindex report) · turn off: `codegraph telemetry off` or `CODEGRAPH_TELEMETRY=0`
en.panel.telemetryUnknown: Anonymous usage statistics: status unknown (the CLI output had no recognizable status line)
en.panel.title: Codegraph console
en.panel.uninitTitle: codegraph uninit: delete this project’s .codegraph/ (all index data is lost; source files are untouched). This is the only destructive action on this card
en.panel.unlockTitle: codegraph unlock: clear the stale lock file blocking indexing (common after an index run was killed). Does nothing when there is no lock
en.placeholder.projectPath: Project path (leave empty to use the default)
en.status.cliFix: Two fixes, pick one: (1) set `command` in the plugin config to that CLI’s absolute path (editing the profile patch triggers a hot reload and a fresh probe); (2) restart the host from a newly opened terminal so the new environment block takes effect.
en.status.cliMissing: ⚠ No runnable CLI command found ({command}) (`--version` failed): neither the systemPrompt capability announcement nor the usage guidance will be injected, and status / search / sync / reindex on this card will fail too.
en.status.cliNote: Note: the host process PATH is fixed when it starts — refreshing the page or reopening the card will not change it. After either fix above, click “Reprobe” to confirm in place; no host restart is needed.
en.status.cliTimeoutHint: This failure is a timeout, not a missing command: most likely the machine was busy while the host was booting (dozens of concurrent child-process spawns, common on Windows; the host now retries automatically at 10s and 30s). Click “Reprobe” once the machine is idle; if it still times out on an idle machine, check the command path and the command itself.
en.status.defaultWarning: ⚠ The directory used by the managed row {shown}{source} is not a valid index: {why}. codegraph_* tools without a loaded project need an explicit projectPath; {fix}
en.status.fixCurrent: The current path {path} already has a valid index — click “Set as default project” to fix it.
en.status.fixOther: Switch the default project to an indexed directory to mount it automatically (or run `codegraph init` in that directory to build an index).
en.status.mcpAligned: MCP: aligned with the row in the MCP card · cwd {cwd}{disabled}{deadCwd}{following}{note}
en.status.mcpExternal: MCP: a manually configured row was found; this plugin does not take it over
en.status.mcpOwn: MCP: managed (this plugin maintains the working directory) · cwd {cwd}{disabled}{deadCwd}{following}{note}
en.status.notAProjectWhy: its .codegraph/ has no index database, so it is not a codegraph project (the home directory is the usual case: ~/.codegraph is the CLI’s own install directory)
en.status.projectNotIndexed: {path}: not indexed, switching has no effect — run codegraph init in that directory first ({via})
en.status.reasonBuiltWith: The index was built by CLI {built}, while the current CLI is {current}
en.status.reasonExtraction: The index extractor version {built} is behind the current {current}
en.status.reasonWorktree: The index does not match the current worktree
en.status.staleWarning: ⚠ The index may be stale: {reasons}. MCP tools are currently serving a graph produced by an older extractor — click “Reindex” to fix it (in this state Sync reports Already up to date and does not solve it).

zh.card.desc: 代码图谱：索引状态、符号搜索、callers/callees/impact、一键 sync/index。
zh.card.summary: 代码图谱：索引状态、符号搜索、探索/上下文、影响面分析、一键 sync/index。
zh.error.noClipboard: 当前环境没有 navigator.clipboard（非安全上下文？）
zh.hint.queryButtons: 搜索 = 符号列表（可点进详情）· 探索 = 相关符号源码 + 调用链 · 上下文 = 为任务组装上下文 · 三者都用左侧关键词
zh.list.noIndexHint: 该目录还没有索引：点下方「初始化索引」即可在本目录跑一次 `codegraph init`（只创建 .codegraph/，源文件不动；可用 `codegraph uninit` 撤销）。
zh.list.noSymbols: 没有匹配的符号。换个关键词，或去掉「类型」过滤。
zh.list.outputTruncated: 输出较长：只显示了前 {shown} 字符（共 {total} 字符）
zh.list.truncatedShown: 已显示前 {shown} 条，共 {total} 条
zh.meta.adoptionMain: 采纳率：codegraph {codegraph} 次 / 发现类 {discovery} 次 → {narrow}%
zh.meta.adoptionNoDiscovery: 采纳率：还没有发现类调用（codegraph {codegraph} 次 / 读取 {file} 次；另 {other} 次其它工具）
zh.meta.adoptionNoDiscoveryCalls: 采纳率：还没有探索类调用（另 {other} 次其它工具，如 bash / edit）
zh.meta.adoptionNoRecords: 采纳率：本次宿主运行期间该项目还没有工具调用记录
zh.meta.adoptionUnindexed: （该项目未索引，这个数字不代表提示词效果）
zh.msg.cancelSent: 已发送取消请求：CLI 进程正在被终止（SIGTERM，3s 后强制）。
zh.msg.copyUnavailable: 自动复制不可用（{error}）：诊断包已展开在下方，手动全选复制即可。
zh.msg.defaultSet: 已把默认项目切到 {path}{session}，并关闭「跟随当前项目」；codegraph MCP 服务器将热切换。
zh.msg.followOff: 已关闭跟随，托管行使用默认项目
zh.msg.mcpScopeManaged: 已切回 managed：全局托管行已恢复，per-agent 挂载已回收
zh.msg.mcpScopePerAgent: 已切到 per-agent：新会话将各挂一个独立的 MCP 进程（已开的会话也会补挂）
zh.msg.noMatchingFiles: 索引里没有匹配的文件
zh.msg.reportCopied: 诊断包已复制到剪贴板。
zh.msg.reprobeFailed: 重新探测完成：CLI 仍不可用，原因见下方。
zh.msg.reprobeOk: 重新探测成功：CLI 可用，systemPrompt 两段已注入。
zh.msg.switched: 已切换到 {path}，并关闭「跟随当前项目」；codegraph MCP 服务器将热切换。
zh.msg.uninitDone: 已撤销 {path} 的索引（.codegraph/ 已删除，源文件未动）：{output}
zh.panel.adoptionTitle: 来自宿主的内存计数（session/event 的 tool/call），宿主重启即归零；项目按索引根归并。「文件探索」= grep/glob/read 这类本可交给 codegraph 的工具，bash 等不计入
zh.panel.affectedButtonTitle: codegraph affected <files>：由改动文件反查受影响的测试。用左侧「改动文件」里的列表
zh.panel.affectedTitle: codegraph affected <files…>：由改动文件反查受影响的测试。一行一个，也可用逗号分隔；留空则 CLI 回「No files provided」
zh.panel.announceDisabled: codegraph CLI 不可用，公告不会注入
zh.panel.announceTitle: 向 agent 注入本插件的能力公告（一段中文提示，告诉模型有这张卡片）
zh.panel.cancelTitle: 终止正在跑的 codegraph CLI（SIGTERM，3s 后整组 SIGKILL）
zh.panel.confirmInitTitle: 再点一次即在 {path} 里创建 .codegraph/ 并建立首次索引
zh.panel.confirmUninitTitle: 再点一次即删除 {path} 的 .codegraph/（索引数据全部丢失，源文件不动）
zh.panel.contextTitle: codegraph context：为一个任务组装上下文（相关符号 + 关系 + 代码块）。用左侧搜索框里的关键词
zh.panel.diagnoseTitle: 收集一段可直接复制的诊断文本：CLI 探测实测原文、托管行与补丁区块（值已脱敏）、索引状态、codegraph daemon 与日志尾、最近一次 CLI 失败
zh.panel.exploreTitle: codegraph explore：与 MCP 的 codegraph_explore 同输出（相关符号源码 + 调用路径）。用左侧搜索框里的关键词
zh.panel.filesTitle: codegraph files --json：列出索引里的文件结构（语言 / 符号数 / 大小）。不吃搜索框的关键词
zh.panel.followTitle: 开启后：会话切到某个已索引项目时，MCP 托管行的 cwd 自动对齐它；会话目录没有索引时回落到默认项目。「设为默认项目」会关掉它（那是一次显式指定）
zh.panel.guidanceDisabled: codegraph CLI 不可用，使用指引不会注入
zh.panel.guidanceTitle: 注入 CodeGraph 使用指引（CODEGRAPH_START 区块：何时优先用 codegraph、失败怎么兜底）
zh.panel.impactTitle: 影响面 (impact) · {nodes} 个节点 / {edges} 条边
zh.panel.initTitle: codegraph index / sync 都要求项目先初始化过（干净目录会报 “CodeGraph not initialized”）。这个按钮在该目录跑一次 `codegraph init`。
zh.panel.kindTitle: codegraph query -k/--kind：按节点类型过滤（function / class / method / interface / type_alias / constant / variable / property / file / import）
zh.panel.limitTitle: codegraph query -l/--limit：返回条数上限（默认 20）。callers/callees 也吃这个值
zh.panel.perAgentActive: per-agent 生效中：已挂载 {count} 个 agent 的独立 MCP 进程。全局托管行已挂起（disabled: true），切回 managed 会自动恢复。
zh.panel.perAgentActiveTitle: 每个 agent 一个独立的 codegraph MCP 进程；会话目录没有可用索引的 agent 不会挂载（避免拿到别的项目上下文）
zh.panel.perAgentFallback: ⚠ per-agent 未生效，已退回 managed：{reason}{tail}
zh.panel.perAgentTail: （当前仍是单服务器按会话热切换，功能正常）
zh.panel.perAgentTitle: 每 agent 一个独立的 codegraph MCP 进程（cwd = 该 agent 会话的索引根）：多项目并行时不再共享一个全局 cwd，也不再需要写盘热切换。代价是每个 agent 一个子进程（约 40MB 内存 / 每个），且只有会话目录真的「有索引」时才挂。
zh.panel.rawDetailJson: 原始 JSON（node / callers / callees / impact）
zh.panel.refreshTitle: 重新读取 `codegraph status --json`，刷新本组的索引状态（不会重建索引）
zh.panel.reportSummary: 诊断包（可整段复制贴 issue）
zh.panel.reprobeTitle: 重跑一次 `<command> --version`：CLI 是后装的、或 command 改成了绝对路径时，无需重启宿主即可恢复
zh.panel.setDefaultTitle: 把当前路径持久化为默认项目（同时关闭「跟随当前项目」，避免被会话切换顶掉），codegraph MCP 服务器的工作目录随之热切换
zh.panel.syncTitle: codegraph sync：增量同步索引（只更新改动的部分；全量重建用右边的「重建索引」）
zh.panel.telemetryOn: 匿名用量统计：已开启（init / 重建索引会上报）· 关闭：`codegraph telemetry off` 或 `CODEGRAPH_TELEMETRY=0`
zh.panel.telemetryUnknown: 匿名用量统计：状态未知（CLI 输出未含可识别的状态行）
zh.panel.title: Codegraph 控制台
zh.panel.uninitTitle: codegraph uninit：删除该项目的 .codegraph/（索引数据全部丢失，源文件不动）。这是本卡片唯一的删除类动作
zh.panel.unlockTitle: codegraph unlock：清掉挡住索引的陈旧锁文件（索引被强杀后常见）。没锁时什么也不做
zh.placeholder.projectPath: 项目路径（留空使用默认）
zh.status.cliFix: 修法二选一：① 把插件配置里的 command 写成该 CLI 的绝对路径（改 profile 补丁会触发热重载并重新探测）；② 从新开的终端重启宿主，让新的环境块生效。
zh.status.cliMissing: ⚠ 探测不到可执行的 CLI 命令 {command}（`--version` 失败）：systemPrompt 的能力公告与使用指引都不会注入，卡片里的状态 / 搜索 / sync / 重建索引也会报错。
zh.status.cliNote: 注意：宿主进程的 PATH 在它启动时就固定了，刷新页面 / 重开卡片都不会改变它——改完上面任一项后，点「重新探测」即可就地确认，不必重启宿主。
zh.status.cliTimeoutHint: 这次失败是「超时」而不是「命令不存在」：多半是宿主启动时机器繁忙（大量子进程并发 spawn，Windows 上常见；宿主会在超时后于 10s / 30s 各自动重试一次）。等机器空闲后点「重新探测」即可；若空闲时仍超时，再检查 command 路径与命令本身。
zh.status.defaultWarning: ⚠ 托管行用的目录 {shown}{source} 不是有效索引：{why}。未加载项目的 codegraph_* 工具需要显式传 projectPath；{fix}
zh.status.fixCurrent: 当前路径 {path} 已是有效索引，点「设为默认项目」即可修复。
zh.status.fixOther: 把默认项目切到已索引目录即可自动挂载（也可以直接在该目录里运行 `codegraph init` 建索引）。
zh.status.mcpAligned: MCP：已对齐 MCP 卡片里的行 · cwd {cwd}{disabled}{deadCwd}{following}{note}
zh.status.mcpExternal: MCP：检测到手工配置行，插件不接管
zh.status.mcpOwn: MCP：已托管（本插件维护工作目录）· cwd {cwd}{disabled}{deadCwd}{following}{note}
zh.status.notAProjectWhy: 它的 .codegraph/ 里没有索引库，不是 codegraph 项目（家目录最常见：~/.codegraph 是 CLI 自身的安装目录）
zh.status.projectNotIndexed: {path}：未索引，切换无效——先在该目录跑 codegraph init（{via}）
zh.status.reasonBuiltWith: 索引由 CLI {built} 构建，当前 CLI 是 {current}
zh.status.reasonExtraction: 索引的提取器版本 {built} 已落后于当前的 {current}
zh.status.reasonWorktree: 索引与当前 worktree 不匹配
zh.status.staleWarning: ⚠ 索引可能过期：{reasons}。MCP 工具此刻给的是旧提取器产出的图——点「重建索引」修复（实测此时 Sync 会报 Already up to date 且不解决问题）。
